_what: C-9 R-C9-110 -- her Fire Ball's impact blast condensed (Matt: 'a bit too wide/large of a blast zone. It needs to be condensed a bit'), behind ?fb=c75 (desktop -- --fb c75). drax.
how: rescaled AT PLACEMENT, no re-bake: the burst and its floor light draw in the flipbook shader's MODE 2 -- the display radius u (of 0.75 x the burst's 250 px reach) reads the source at u^1.35, so the CORE keeps its size and density while the outer flames and the flash's spread come in to 0.75; same frames, same brightness, same duration; the projectile and its travel untouched. The drawn quad is a square about the burst's point (the remap bends the frame's edges); the fragment reads only inside the frame's own rect
gameplay_radius: none: the Fire Ball has no hit area in the build (no damage or hit radius in knight.gd / sorceress_knight.gd / spell_fx.gd); the visual is the whole blast

visual_radius_m._: area-equivalent radius of the burst's painted pixels at its widest frame (tick 12-16 after spawn), play camera, phone look (Compatibility), 1920x1080, 100.6 px/m

budget._: desktop Forward+, --perf fb (20 slash casts, matched control); draws unchanged (one MultiMesh, the same instances)

fences: tools/build_web_painted.sh: ?fb=c75 launches with fire_ball=baked(...)+c75 and no script/shader error; the default word unchanged
film: Desktop review folder: 'C-9 sorceress Fire Ball c75 (burst condensed to 0.75) - ... play speed then quarter speed.mp4' and 'C-9 Fire Ball burst before vs fb=c75 - at its peak.png'
